'''Sandy Wible Winning Palace Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sandy Wible]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]]
* '''Strategy:''' Winning Palace Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Winning Palace Deck Wible LS 1997.txt |Download]]
